scope: Two existing E fixtures, same-engine arithmetic checks only; no independent cross-engine intervention validation
unit_source: results/followup-v3-gemma-map/engineering_engine/validation.json; already selected engineering neurons, no reselection
greedy_eog_policy: Record EOG IDs but continue exactly four arithmetic diagnostic steps; this does not test normal EOG stopping behavior
cache_schedule: One token per forward including prompt prefill; compare every prompt position against one full uncached forward
precision: float32, eager attention, TF32 disabled, no autocast
failure_policy: Preserve all measured errors and mark FAIL; do not relax criteria or overwrite earlier artifacts
